description: Surface container. Hairline border on the base surface scale; depth comes from the shadow, never a gradient.

content.description: The card's body, below the optional header.

action.description: Right-aligned in the header, beside the title. Arena draws the header row; the consumer draws what sits in it.

title.description: Header title. Absent, along with eyebrow and action, renders no header block at all.

eyebrow.description: Mono uppercase label above the title, in the accent colour.

floating.description: Adds the warm shadow. Depth comes from the shadow and the surface scale, never a gradient.

accent.description: Draws the border in the accent colour instead of the surface hairline.
